craft.label: Blockcraft
craft.profile:
@prefix ga:   <https://tesseractsemantics.com/ns/asset-passport/ga#> .
@prefix owl:  <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix rdf:  <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix sh:   <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix craft: <https://tesseractsemantics.com/ns/asset-passport/craft#> .

# Blockcraft: a block-building survival game. A player has 20 hit points, drawn
# as ten hearts, and every number is whole. There are no elemental types, and
# nothing can own a mob.

craft:game a ga:Game ; rdfs:label "Blockcraft" ; ga:maxPlayerHealth 20 ; ga:wholeNumbersOnly true .

craft:Item a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf ga:Item ;
    rdfs:subClassOf [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty ga:fromGame ; owl:hasValue craft:game ] .
craft:DiamondSword a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf ga:Weapon ; rdfs:label "Diamond sword" .
craft:TNT a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf ga:Explosive ; rdfs:label "TNT" .
craft:GoldenApple a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf ga:HealingConsumable ; rdfs:label "Golden apple" .

craft:attack a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:subPropertyOf ga:baseDamage .
craft:blastDamage a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:subPropertyOf ga:baseDamage .
craft:heals a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:subPropertyOf ga:healAmount .
craft:bonusHearts a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:subPropertyOf ga:bonusHealth .
craft:material a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:subPropertyOf ga:madeOf .
craft:name a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:subPropertyOf rdfs:label .

# Blockcraft's materials, placed on the hub's type scale. Read each axiom as
# "anything made of diamond is Rock-typed". Gold is deliberately not placed.
[ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty ga:madeOf ; owl:hasValue craft:Diamond ]
    rdfs:subClassOf [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty ga:elementalType ; owl:hasValue ga:Rock ] .
[ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty ga:madeOf ; owl:hasValue craft:Stone ]
    rdfs:subClassOf [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty ga:elementalType ; owl:hasValue ga:Rock ] .
[ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty ga:madeOf ; owl:hasValue craft:Iron ]
    rdfs:subClassOf [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty ga:elementalType ; owl:hasValue ga:Steel ] .
[ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty ga:madeOf ; owl:hasValue craft:Wood ]
    rdfs:subClassOf [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty ga:elementalType ; owl:hasValue ga:Grass ] .

battle.label: Pocket Battlers
battle.profile:
@prefix ga:   <https://tesseractsemantics.com/ns/asset-passport/ga#> .
@prefix owl:  <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix rdf:  <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix sh:   <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix battle: <https://tesseractsemantics.com/ns/asset-passport/battle#> .

# Pocket Battlers: a turn-based creature battler. A creature has 100 hit points,
# every number is whole, and every move has an elemental type.

battle:game a ga:Game ; rdfs:label "Pocket Battlers" ; ga:maxPlayerHealth 100 ;
    ga:wholeNumbersOnly true ; ga:hasElementalTypes true .

battle:Item a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf ga:Item ;
    rdfs:subClassOf [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty ga:fromGame ; owl:hasValue battle:game ] .
battle:Emberfox a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf ga:Creature ; rdfs:label "Emberfox" .
battle:CaptureOrb a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf ga:CaptureDevice ; rdfs:label "Capture orb" .
battle:SuperPotion a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf ga:HealingConsumable ; rdfs:label "Super potion" .

battle:hp a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:subPropertyOf ga:hitPoints .
battle:movePower a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:subPropertyOf ga:baseDamage .
battle:moveName a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:subPropertyOf ga:moveName .
battle:restoresHp a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:subPropertyOf ga:healAmount .
battle:catchRate a owl:DatatypeProperty .
battle:type a owl:ObjectProperty .
battle:name a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:subPropertyOf rdfs:label .

# Pocket Battlers' type names, placed on the hub's type scale.
[ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty battle:type ; owl:hasValue battle:Fire ]
    rdfs:subClassOf [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty ga:elementalType ; owl:hasValue ga:Fire ] .
[ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty battle:type ; owl:hasValue battle:Water ]
    rdfs:subClassOf [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty ga:elementalType ; owl:hasValue ga:Water ] .
[ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty battle:type ; owl:hasValue battle:Grass ]
    rdfs:subClassOf [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty ga:elementalType ; owl:hasValue ga:Grass ] .
[ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty battle:type ; owl:hasValue battle:Rock ]
    rdfs:subClassOf [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty ga:elementalType ; owl:hasValue ga:Rock ] .

files.hub:
@prefix ga:   <https://tesseractsemantics.com/ns/asset-passport/ga#> .
@prefix owl:  <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix rdf:  <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix sh:   <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

# The Game Asset core. Every game maps its own words into this hub, so N games
# need N mappings, not N squared. It says what a thing IS. Numbers stay in the
# source game's units until the receiving game's declared rule converts them.

<https://tesseractsemantics.com/ns/asset-passport/ga> a owl:Ontology ;
    rdfs:label "Asset Passport: Game Asset core" ; owl:versionInfo "0.2.0" .

ga:Item a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Item" ;
    rdfs:comment "Anything that can cross from one game into another: a tool, a consumable, a creature." .
ga:Weapon a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf ga:Item ; rdfs:label "Weapon" .
